description: Throughput-focused revision: iteration 1 queues (46-58 m vs 13 m) and discharge headways (0.5-0.96 s vs 0.3-0.39 s) were far too large in all specs, so sigma/tau/minGap are lowered, the slow-rider archetype and slow_lane_center rule (blocking, 'lateral_target_not_reached' thousands of times) are dropped, red-running/early-start are strengthened, right-lane and sidewalk rates retuned, box rule follows the best it01 box settings.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 0.84-0.96 s vs 0.39 s) and M5/length: tau 0.7, minGap 1.2, accel 3.5 and sigma 0.1 shorten the following gap and the start-up lag so the queue clears faster; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.
Targets M1/car and M8/car: a minority with tau 0.6 and accel 4 discharges tighter, lcAssertive 2 accepts smaller lane-change gaps.

Targets M1/moto (0.52-0.63 s vs 0.30 s), M5/length and M3/share/moto (0.02 vs 0.09): minimal tau/minGap/sigma and max accel pack and discharge riders faster; impatience 0.6 with jmDriveAfterRedTime 6 s and jmDriveRedSpeed 8 m/s lets riders enter on red; wide lateral freedom (minGapLat 0.3, lcSublane 4) targets M4/overshoot_share.
Space-seeking riders (custom1) for M10a (0.27/cycle target; it01 gave 0.03-0.8) and M3/per_cycle; same fast-discharge parameters as moto_std so they do not lengthen M5/length.
Targets M7a/n_waiting (1.9-3.9 vs 5.5), M7b/clear_lag and M6/junction/illegal_l: it01_s03 settings (clear_lag 6.0 s vs 6.65 s) kept, sigma lowered for faster box exit.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (0.004-0.007 vs 0.13): most attempts ended 'red_ended_before_crossing', so the window is widened to 10 s, v_max raised to 4 m/s so the rider crosses before green, and p raised to 0.5; cars excluded (M2/early/car ~0.001).
Targets M3/per_cycle (0.4-1.0 vs 4.4) and M3/share/moto (0.02 vs 0.09): p0 raised from 0.04-0.15 to 0.25 with swarm gain k 0.1 to keep var/mean near 1.3.

Targets M9a/M9b (right-lane use 0.9-4.6/cycle vs 0.33, blocked share 0.15-0.30 vs 0.02): p_right_lane cut to 0.01; M10a (0.27/cycle): p_sidewalk 0.07 on a 20% seeker share sits between it01 s00 (0.21 at 0.06x10%) and s02 (0.82); p_wrong_lane 0 as it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27) and would be redistributed.
Targets M7a/release_time (0.36 s with lag 1 vs 2.59 s) and M7b/clear_lag: a longer extra hold of 2 s moves box exit later toward the observed value.
